theorem.consequence: NO UNIVERSAL POLYNOMIAL-SIZE EXACT REAL LP EXTENDED FORMULATION OF THE FULL BOOLEAN RANK-ONE MOMENT HULL
theorem.graph_positive_control: xc(COR(G))=2^{O(tw(G)+log n)}; bounded treewidth yields polynomial-size EF
theorem.janus_width_lemma: After affine equality contraction, every clause contributes all three boundary product edges ab,ac,bc, so primal(F) is a subgraph of the JANUS semantic product graph; universal bounded treewidth is therefore unavailable.

keymaster_barrier.scope: FULL BOOLEAN MOMENT HULL / EXACT REAL LINEAR EXTENDED FORMULATIONS ONLY. DOES NOT BLOCK NONLINEAR, MATROIDAL, MATCHING, RECURSIVE, OR SPECIAL-SPARSE SUBCLASS ALGORITHMS.

sources: Kaibel-Weltge, A Short Proof that the Extension Complexity of the Correlation Polytope Grows Exponentially, arXiv:1307.3543
